response.overview: Without anyone to rely on, Jiho moves into a new boarding house and meets its kind landlady, Kyeong-sun. After Jiho suffers a strange nightmare on her first night, Kyeong-sun offers her a warm meal. However, as Jiho opens her heart, Kyeong-sun's control grows increasingly suffocating, and Jiho senses another presence staying in the house. Driven by suspicion, Jiho sneaks into the basement and uncovers Kyeong-sun’s dark secret, only to be caught by her. In the end, Jiho comes to realize that she has become a ghost of the boarding house.
response.title: Welcome back
